description: This PHP script interacts with the Redmine API to retrieve issue details and add a note to a specific issue. It includes setup for multiple Redmine site configurations, fetches issue data, displays some of its properties, and then adds a note to the issue via the API.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class for interacting with the Redmine REST API, providing methods for fetching issues and adding notes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the redmine object with the API URL and key.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: addIssueNoteFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Adds a note to a specific issue using an XML object.
